raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.25"

recipe:
  name: bullet
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c45afb6399e3f68036ddb641c6bf6f552bf332d5ab6be62f7e6c54eda05ceb77
  patches:
    - devendorzlib.patch
    - double-precision-postfix.patch
    - if: linux
      then: add_rt.patch
    - if: ppc64le
      then:
        # On ppc64le compilation of Bullet3OpenCL fails (https://github.com/conda-forge/bullet-feedstock/issues/24)
        - disable-bullet3opencl.patch
        # The setup.py hardcodes a custom logic to decide the number of compilation threads,
        # let's override it for memory limited architectures (as of early 2021, travis with ppc64le)
        - setup-py-single-thread-compilation.patch

build:
  number: 6

outputs:
  - package:
      name: bullet-cpp
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: build_cpp.sh
          else: bld_cpp.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake <4
        - ninja
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
      host:
        # No python here on purpose: bullet-cpp is independent of the Python version,
        # the Python bindings are built from source in the pybullet output
        - if: linux
          then: libgl-devel
        - if: unix
          then:
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-libxext
      run:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-libxext
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('bullet-cpp', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - bullet/BulletSoftBody/btSoftBody.h
          files:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - lib/pkgconfig/bullet.pc
                - lib/cmake/bullet/BulletConfig.cmake
              else:
                - Library/lib/cmake/bullet/BulletConfig.cmake
                - Library/lib/BussIK.lib
                - Library/lib/BulletCollision.lib
          lib:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - BulletExampleBrowserLib
                - gwen
                - BussIK
                - Bullet3Dynamics

  - package:
      name: pybullet
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: build_py.sh
          else: bld_py.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
        - cmake <4
        - ninja
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("bullet-cpp", exact=True) }}
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - wheel
        - numpy
        - zlib
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("bullet-cpp", exact=True) }}
        - python
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - pybullet
          pip_check: false

  - package:
      name: bullet
    requirements:
      host:
        # Not a real dependency, it ensures that there is one variant of this output per Python version
        - python
        - numpy
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("bullet-cpp", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("pybullet", exact=True) }}
        - python
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - pybullet
          pip_check: false

about:
  homepage: http://bulletphysics.org
  license: Zlib
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: |
    Bullet Physics SDK real-time collision detection and multi-physics
    simulation for VR, games, visual effects, robotics, machine learning
    etc.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - traversaro
    - wolfv
